device: iPhone 17 Pro (iPhone18,1), iOS 27.0 (24A437), USB (charging), screen on
app: ondevice/_ane_gate/bench (AppleBenchRunnerGA, Apple llm-benchmark method on Apple main 7359dbc, both arms embedded, one launch per arm)

protocol.ab: p128 g256 n5, order A-B-A-B, 20 s between launches, no-console launches (file-mirrored log)
protocol.sustain_v2: per arm: engine released, idle >= 60 s and until ProcessInfo.thermalState <= fair (cap 600 s), load, warmup, p128 g256 trials for 60 s; thermal/battery logged per trial

arms.minicpm5_2b_ane_pal6g8: MiniCPM5-2B iOS static, 6-bit k-means g8 (Apple's qwen3-1.7b iOS preset shape), AOT h18p neural-engine 31/31 regions, devbundle 2.5 GB — StaticShapeEngine / ANE
arms.minicpm5_2b_gpu_int8: the shipped int8/ (int8 per-block-32, dynamic) — pipelined engine / GPU

ab_read: Both arms depressed: the A/B ran right after a 23-minute cold ANE program build and three gate runs; the sustain run that followed found thermalState=serious at its start. Same phone state for both arms (interleaved), absolute values not nominal.
sustain_read: Thermal-recovered numbers (idle until fair): 6-bit ANE 38.5 tok/s decode, flat over 60 s (thermal stays fair); GPU int8 23.8 mean, 26.0 -> 21.6 within the minute (thermal reaches serious). The shipped 4-bit ANE bundle measured 54.8 / 55.7 tok/s (n=1) in fresh containers earlier the same morning (cold-cache experiments, not interleaved with these).
fidelity: 6-bit ANE: device gate natural 24/24, chat 8/8, long 16/16, sky 33 tokens exact then diverges at a 0.168-margin step (5 margin-clear TF flips / 109) — gate-minicpm5-2b-ane-6bit-g8-FAIL.json. GPU int8: fp32-faithful to the floor (S1 probe; the recipe is TF-clean 109/109 in fp32 simulation).
